We use reusable foundations for standard needs such as accounts and dashboards, then tailor the interface, data models, business logic, and integrations to your approved scope. You receive a product shaped around your workflow and your own source code.
What if the scope needs more than 100 hours?

Discovery establishes whether the first release fits the sprint. If the complete idea needs more time, we propose a phased delivery or a separate estimate. Features for later releases are identified before work begins.
Can a first release help validate my business?

A working release lets you demonstrate the experience, collect customer feedback, and decide what to build next. Commercial results depend on your market, positioning, and customer acquisition; delivery does not guarantee revenue.

The base estimate is $10,999. Choose optional AI, mobile, dashboard, integration, or launch capabilities in the builder. The signed proposal confirms scope, external costs, applicable fees, and any supported payment discount.

The handoff includes your source repository, deployed application, and operating documentation. Fourteen days of fixes and adjustments are included as agreed. Ongoing maintenance can be arranged separately, or your own team can continue the work.
